svg.title: ESP32-S3 physical pinout and Samsung AC IR circuit
ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 physical header reference for AC IR test
svg.text: Antenna at top; USB connectors at bottom.
Match your board’s printed labels before wiring.
21 = 5V; 22 = GND. Numbers count from the top.
* GPIO35–37 are reserved for octal PSRAM on N16R8.
GPIO numbers and header positions are different concepts.
WROOM-1 identifies the module, not the carrier-board layout.
Reference: Espressif DevKitC-1 v1.1 J1/J3 header tables.

g.title: ESP32-S3 Samsung AC IR transmitter and receiver schematic
g.text: USB powered • GPIO4: IR transmit • GPIO5: IR receive
Matching 3V3 and GPIO5 labels are electrically connected to U1 above.
C3 goes close to U2. Verify its physical pin order; this symbol uses functional pin labels.
Keep the receiver on 3.3 V. R1 = 220 Ω; R5 = 10 kΩ. All grounds are common.
